text:
Predicates:
Eat(x, y) ::: x eats y regularly.
Conscious(x) ::: x is very conscious about their health and eating habits.
GrewUp(x, y) ::: x grew up in y childhood homes.
FulfillDailyIntakes(x) ::: x fulfills their nutritional daily intakes.
GoodRelationship(x, y) ::: x has a good relationship with y.
VisitGym(x) ::: x visits the gym at least once a day.
Taylor ::: Taylor
Premises:
∀x (Eat(x, salads) → Conscious(x)) ::: All people who eat salads regularly are very conscious about their health and eating habits.
∀x (GrewUp(x, healthConscious) → Eat(x, salads)) ::: All people who grew up in health-conscious childhood homes eat salads regularly.
∀x (FulfillDailyIntakes(x) → GrewUp(x, healthConscious)) ::: All people who fulfill their nutritional daily intakes grew up in health-conscious childhood homes.
∀x (GoodRelationship(x, parents) → FulfillDailyIntakes(x)) ::: If people have good relationships with their parents, then they fulfill their nutritional daily intakes.
∀x (GoodRelationship(x, parents) → ¬Eat(x, salads)) ::: If people have good relationships with their parents, then they do not eat salads regularly.
∀x (VisitGym(x) → FulfillDailyIntakes(x)) ::: If people visit the gym at least once a day, then they always fulfill their daily nutritional intakes.
(GrewUp(taylor, healthConscious) ∧ GoodRelationship(taylor, parents)) ⊕ ¬(GrewUp(taylor, healthConscious) ∨ GoodRelationship(taylor, parents)) ::: It is either both true that Taylor grew up in a health-conscious childhood home and she has a good relationship with her parents, or it is true that Taylor neither grew up in a health-conscious childhood home nor has a good relationship with her parents.
Conclusion:
¬(GrewUp(taylor, healthConscious) ∨ VisitGym(taylor)) ::: Taylor neither grew up in a health-conscious childhood home nor does she visit the gym at least once a day.
